newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Death toll rises to six in Australia landslide.
newsitem.headline: Death toll rises to six in Australia landslide.

text.p: The death toll in Australia's ski lodge disaster rose to six on Saturday with the discovery of three more bodies, police said.
The dead include four men and two women, police said.
Only one body has so far been recovered.
"There were six dead at the latest count," a police spokeswoman told Reuters. Previously, police had put the confirmed death toll at three.

The confirmation of the latest toll came as rescue crews continued attempts to pull from the rubble the only known survivor of a landslide which engulfed two ski lodges late on Wednesday, burying 20 people.
The slide hit just before midnight on Wednesday at the Thredbo Alpine Village in the Snowy Mountains, 400 km (250 miles) south of Sydney.
